locale_rationale: OH1988 is the concrete new reading benefit in 1.0.8. Ukrainian demand is a hypothesis, not established by device-language data in G01.

channels.placement: One Ukrainian benefit section on the owner's Revelation website
channels.measurement: Partner Center MSIX Campaign Conversion page views and installs with cid rev108-uk-site. Search Console records Google Search clicks and impressions. Website visits and first reading remain unmeasured.

channels.placement: Published Ukrainian Microsoft Store listing with the OH1988 description and gallery from REV237
channels.measurement: Store Acquisitions page view and install totals and internal Store source. Campaign-attributed views are already included in totals.

observations.windows_installs_semantics: Overview reported total only; detailed chart has no data and November 21 is missing. Full seven-day install total is unknown.

acquisitions.campaign_status: No rows in either installs or page views; absent CID is not treated as zero.

usage.status: No data available for requested window; zero overview tile is not accepted as a measured zero.

collection.method: Authorized Partner Center and Search Console browser reports; AI11 through MCP
collection.original_scheduled_run: Ended by restoring the chat title without collecting metrics; recovered in the same chat on November 24.
collection.aggregate_qa_exclusion: No public campaign visits or installs were performed for this collection. Aggregate reports cannot identify all owner or other QA traffic; no independent-user count is claimed.
collection.feedback_scope: No reader feedback gathered or solicited in this checkpoint.

observations.conclusion: Insufficient evidence to attribute traffic or installs to the Ukrainian page. Partial Store data, absent CID and unavailable Usage prevent a campaign-effect claim. D14 decision remains pending.

decision_rules.continue: At D14, if 40 Store views and 3 installs are observed, entry points work and feedback shows no repeated reading blocker, retain the tested channel for one more bounded cycle. Small samples do not establish causation.
decision_rules.change: If views reach 40 but installs stay below 3, inspect listing-to-install friction. If installs occur but readers report a blocker, fix the reading path before increasing placements.
decision_rules.insufficient_data: With fewer than 40 views or missing/partial reporting, record insufficient evidence. Do not call missing data zero or claim a failed Ukrainian module.
decision_rules.stop: Stop the placement when its advertised module cannot be obtained or a reproducible reading blocker appears. Preserve evidence and do not replace the approved scope with new channels.

D7_repeat.scope: Recheck missing Microsoft Store data for November 15-21; retain the original checkpoint.
